# This script is meant to prime LTMP benthic data for my ReefMod analysis 
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringi)
library(stringr)
library(tibble)

```


```{r reef names}

# Part 1: extracting and saving all reef names to be cleaned
   
habitat1 <- comp2021_Aug2026 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(AIMS_REEF_NAME = toupper(AIMS_REEF_NAME))
  
habnames <- comp2021_groups %>%
  glimpse()

# ReefMod names
gbr_polygons <- read.csv("C:/Users/s4657929/OneDrive - The University of Queensland/Nidhi-LTMP-analysis/Data/GBR_REEF_POLYGONS.csv")

reefmod_names <- unique(gbr_polygons$GBR_NAME)
unique(habitat1$REEF_NAME)
  
aims_reef_name <- unique(toupper(habitat1$AIMS_REEF_NAME))
print(aims_reef_name)

reef_name <- unique(habitat1$REEF_NAME)

reeflist <- list(first = aims_reef_name, second = reef_name, third = reefmod_names)
n <- max(lengths(reeflist))

reefnames <- as.data.frame(lapply(reeflist, `length<-`, n))
colnames(reefnames) <- c("aims_reef_name", "reef_name", "reefmod_reef_name")

# write.csv(reefnames, file = "All reef names.csv", row.names = TRUE)

```


```{r merging and checking for overlap}

# bringing back cleaned reef names 
cleaned_reefnames <- read.csv("C:/Users/s4657929/OneDrive - The University of Queensland/Nidhi-LTMP-analysis/Reef names/Cleaned reef names.csv")
colnames(cleaned_reefnames)[1] <- "AIMS_REEF_NAME"

unique(habitat1$SHELF) # I, M, O

p_code <- c(unique(habitat1$P_CODE)) # IN, RAP, RM, RMRAP

# checking which reefs fall under which P_CODE
LTMP_split <- habitat1 %>%
  distinct(P_CODE, AIMS_REEF_NAME) %>%
  group_by(P_CODE) %>%
  summarise(reefs = list(AIMS_REEF_NAME)) 

# overlapping reefs
overlapping <- habitat1 %>%
  distinct(P_CODE, AIMS_REEF_NAME) %>%
  group_by(AIMS_REEF_NAME) %>%
  filter(n() > 1) %>%
  summarise(codes = paste(sort(P_CODE), collapse = ", "), n_codes = n()) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_codes))

# finding overlapping years 
reef_codes <- habitat1 %>%
  distinct(AIMS_REEF_NAME, P_CODE, REPORT_YEAR) %>%
  group_by(AIMS_REEF_NAME, REPORT_YEAR) %>%
  mutate(multi_in_year = n_distinct(P_CODE) > 1) %>%      
  group_by(AIMS_REEF_NAME) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(P_CODE) > 1) %>%        
  group_by(AIMS_REEF_NAME, P_CODE) %>%
  summarise(shared_years = paste(sort(unique(REPORT_YEAR[multi_in_year])), collapse = ", "),
            .groups = "drop")%>%
  dplyr::filter(shared_years != "")


```

```{r creating dataset}

# Average coral cover at each shelf position for each reef per year
habitat <- left_join (habitat1, cleaned_reefnames, by = "AIMS_REEF_NAME") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!(AIMS_REEF_NAME == "MIDDLE REEF")) %>%
  group_by(SHELF, AIMS_REEF_NAME, FULLREEF_ID, REEF_LAT, REEF_LONG, REPORT_YEAR, COMP_2021, reefmod_ID)%>%
  summarise(avgcover = mean(COVER))

head(habitat)

#wide format
habitat_wide <- habitat %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = COMP_2021,
    values_from = avgcover,
    values_fill = 0
  )

head(habitat_wide)

# coral cover
```

```{r ReefMod coral types}

coral_types <- c("Plating corals", "Arborescent (staghorn) corals", "Corymbose/small branching acroporids", "Pocilloporids and other non-acroporid corymbose", "Small massive/submassive/encrusting corals", "Large massive")

reefmod_map <- tribble(
  ~COMP_2021,              ~ReefMod_code, ~ReefMod_type,                                   ~Note,

  # --- G1: Plating corals (e.g. A. hyacinthus, A. cytherea) ---
  "ACSE",                  "G1", "Plating corals", "",
  "G_TUR_DUN",             "G1", "Plating corals", "judgement call",
  "F_AGA_CF",              "G1", "Plating corals", "",
  "F_FUN_CECF",            "G1", "Plating corals", "",
  "G_PAC",                 "G1", "Plating corals", "judgement call",
  "G_MON",                 "G1", "Plating corals", "judgement call: Montipora spans several forms",
  "G_MER",                 "G1", "Plating corals", "",
  "G_ECH_OTH",             "G1", "Plating corals", "",

  # --- G2: Arborescent (staghorn) corals (e.g. A. muricata, A. nobilis, A. robusta) ---
  "ACBX",                  "G2", "Arborescent (staghorn) corals", "",
  "ACD",                   "G2", "Arborescent (staghorn) corals", "judgement call: digitate Acropora not listed by Bozec & Mumby",

  # --- G3: Corymbose / small branching acroporids (e.g. A. millepora, A. humilis) ---
  "ACTO",                  "G3", "Corymbose/small branching acroporids", "",

  # --- G4: Pocilloporids & other non-acroporid corymbose (e.g. S. pistillata) ---
  "G_POC",                 "G4", "Pocilloporids & other non-acroporid corymbose", "",

non_coral <- c("SC", "SP", "MA", "CA", "TA", "SG", "OT", "AB", "IN")

ltmp_reefmod <- habitat1 %>%
  left_join( cleaned_reefnames, by = "AIMS_REEF_NAME") %>%
  left_join(reefmod_map %>% select(COMP_2021, ReefMod_code, ReefMod_type),
            by = "COMP_2021") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!ReefMod_code %in% non_coral)  %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!(AIMS_REEF_NAME == "MIDDLE REEF"),
                !(P_CODE == "IN" & ((AIMS_REEF_NAME %in% c("FITZROY ISLAND", "HAVANNAH ISLAND") & REPORT_YEAR %in% c(2005, 2007, 2009, 2011, 2013, 2015, 2017, 2019, 2021:2025)) | (AIMS_REEF_NAME == "PANDORA REEF" & REPORT_YEAR %in% c(2005, 2007, 2009, 2011, 2013, 2017, 2021:2025)))))

reefmod_input <- ltmp_reefmod %>%
  dplyr::group_by(SHELF, A_SECTOR, REPORT_YEAR, reefmod_ID, AIMS_REEF_NAME, SITE_NO, TRANSECT_NO, ReefMod_code, REEF_LAT, REEF_LONG) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(COVER = sum(COVER, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = ReefMod_code, values_from = COVER, values_fill = 0) 

write.csv(reefmod_input,
          file = here::here("Data", "reefmod_input.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

length(unique(reefmod_input$AIMS_REEF_NAME))

head(reefmod_input)
```
